steps.en: OCMS successfully receives and updates the details from PLUS
steps.id: OCMS berhasil menerima dan memperbarui data dari PLUS

steps.en: OCMS sends a success alert message to PLUS
steps.id: OCMS mengirim pesan sukses ke PLUS
steps.why_en: OCMS only returns a success reply to PLUS's own request; it does not push a separate alert.
steps.why_id: OCMS hanya membalas sukses atas permintaan PLUS; tidak mengirim alert terpisah.

steps.en: A failed update is never reported to PLUS as a success
steps.id: Update yang gagal tidak pernah dilaporkan sebagai sukses ke PLUS
